title: Vibrant Indian Curry Bowl
description: A flavorful and nutritious curry dish made with vibrant vegetables, served over a bed of rice, perfect for a gluten-free meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add bell pepper and cook for an additional 3 minutes.
Add tomato and cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let cook for 10-15 minutes.
Cook basmati rice according to package instructions.
Serve curry over rice and enjoy!
Optional: garnish with fresh cilantro or scallions.
